title.kn: ಆಢಾವೆ ಪತ್ರ: ಗುಂಪುಗೂಡಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ರಮಬದ್ಧ ಜೋಡಣೆ

hook.en: The profit and loss account is like a film of the whole year. The balance sheet is a photograph of what the business owns and owes on one day.
hook.kn: ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಖಾತೆ ಇಡೀ ವರ್ಷದ ಚಲನಚಿತ್ರದಂತೆ. ಆಢಾವೆ ಪತ್ರವು ಒಂದು ದಿನದಂದು ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಡಬೇಕಾದುದರ ಭಾವಚಿತ್ರ.

objectives.en: Arrange items by liquidity or permanence.

narration.en: The profit and loss account is like a film of the whole year. The balance sheet is a photograph of what the business owns and owes on one day.
narration.kn: ಲಾಭ ನಷ್ಟ ಖಾತೆ ಇಡೀ ವರ್ಷದ ಚಲನಚಿತ್ರದಂತೆ. ಆಢಾವೆ ಪತ್ರವು ಒಂದು ದಿನದಂದು ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಹೊಂದಿರುವ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಡಬೇಕಾದುದರ ಭಾವಚಿತ್ರ.

body.en: A balance sheet is a statement of assets, liabilities and capital on a particular date. It is based on the accounting equation. Assets are grouped as non-current (fixed) assets and current assets; liabilities as long-term (non-current) and current liabilities. Capital is shown with net profit added and drawings deducted.

points.en: Non-current assets: land, building, machinery, furniture
Current assets: stock, debtors, bills receivable, cash, bank
Current liabilities: creditors, bills payable, outstanding expenses

narration.en: A balance sheet is a statement of assets, liabilities and capital on a particular date. It is based on the accounting equation. Assets are grouped as non-current (fixed) assets and current assets; liabilities as long-term (non-current) and current liabilities. Capital is shown with net profit added and drawings deducted.
narration.kn: ಆಢಾವೆ ಪತ್ರ ಒಂದು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ದಿನಾಂಕದ ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳು, ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬಂಡವಾಳದ ಪಟ್ಟಿ. ಇದು ಲೆಕ್ಕಪತ್ರ ಸಮೀಕರಣವನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಿದೆ.

body.en: Grouping means showing similar items under one heading, such as sundry debtors. Marshalling means arranging items in a definite order: either the order of liquidity (cash first, goodwill last) or the order of permanence (goodwill first, cash last).

points.en: Order of liquidity: most liquid first
Order of permanence: most permanent first

narration.en: Grouping means showing similar items under one heading, such as sundry debtors. Marshalling means arranging items in a definite order: either the order of liquidity (cash first, goodwill last) or the order of permanence (goodwill first, cash last).
narration.kn: ಗುಂಪುಗೂಡಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಒಂದೇ ತರಹದ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಒಂದು ಶೀರ್ಷಿಕೆಯಡಿ ತೋರಿಸುವುದು. ಕ್ರಮಬದ್ಧ ಜೋಡಣೆ ದ್ರವ್ಯತೆ ಅಥವಾ ಶಾಶ್ವತತೆಯ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಇರಬಹುದು.

problem.en: Prepare the balance sheet of Sri Rama Traders on 31 March 2025 (order of permanence): Capital ₹1,00,000; Net profit ₹37,000; Drawings ₹7,000; Bank loan ₹40,000; Creditors ₹30,000; Land and building ₹80,000; Furniture ₹20,000; Closing stock ₹25,000; Debtors ₹45,000; Cash ₹30,000.

steps.en: Liabilities side: Capital 1,30,000 + Bank loan 40,000 + Creditors 30,000 = ₹2,00,000.
Assets side (permanence): Land and building 80,000; Furniture 20,000; Closing stock 25,000; Debtors 45,000; Cash 30,000 = ₹2,00,000.
Both sides total ₹2,00,000, so the balance sheet balances.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Prepare the balance sheet of Sri Rama Traders on 31 March 2025 (order of permanence): Capital ₹1,00,000; Net profit ₹37,000; Drawings ₹7,000; Bank loan ₹40,000; Creditors ₹30,000; Land and building ₹80,000; Furniture ₹20,000; Closing stock ₹25,000; Debtors ₹45,000; Cash ₹30,000.

heading.en: Liquidity vs permanence: think of cash

body.en: Liquidity: start with the most liquid, cash in hand. Permanence: start with the most permanent, goodwill, and end with cash. One order is simply the reverse of the other.

narration.en: Liquidity vs permanence: think of cash. Liquidity: start with the most liquid, cash in hand. Permanence: start with the most permanent, goodwill, and end with cash. One order is simply the reverse of the other.

mnemonic.en: Liquidity: Cash comes first. Permanence: Cash comes last.

narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ತಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡವೂ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

points.en: The balance sheet shows financial position on a particular date.
points.kn: ಆಢಾವೆ ಪತ್ರ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ದಿನಾಂಕದ ಹಣಕಾಸು ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Closing capital = Opening capital + Net profit − Drawings.
points.kn: ಅಂತಿಮ ಬಂಡವಾಳ = ಆರಂಭಿಕ ಬಂಡವಾಳ + ನಿವ್ವಳ ಲಾಭ − ಸ್ವಂತ ಬಳಕೆ.

points.en: Items are marshalled by liquidity or by permanence.
points.kn: ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ದ್ರವ್ಯತೆ ಅಥವಾ ಶಾಶ್ವತತೆಯ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

homework.en: Rewrite the worked balance sheet in the order of liquidity.

narration.en: Recap. The balance sheet shows financial position on a particular date. Assets = Liabilities + Capital. Closing capital = Opening capital + Net profit − Drawings. Items are marshalled by liquidity or by permanence.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆಢಾವೆ ಪತ್ರ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ದಿನಾಂಕದ ಹಣಕಾಸು ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳು = ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆಗಳು + ಬಂಡವಾಳ. ಅಂತಿಮ ಬಂಡವಾಳ = ಆರಂಭಿಕ ಬಂಡವಾಳ + ನಿವ್ವಳ ಲಾಭ − ಸ್ವಂತ ಬಳಕೆ. ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ದ್ರವ್ಯತೆ ಅಥವಾ ಶಾಶ್ವತತೆಯ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
